_note: `slot="x"` on a component names a slot of its parent only when the parent is a component: svelte2tsx drops the attribute for a text value when the nearest enclosing element, component or snippet is a component, looking through {#if}/{#each}/{#await}/{#key}, and otherwise passes it as an ordinary prop. A component inside a {#snippet}, a <div>, a <svelte:boundary> or a <svelte:fragment>, or at the top level, therefore gets a `slot` prop it may not declare, and a `slot="{x}"` value is always a prop. Such a component's `let:` reads its own default slot (`item` is the inner Legacy's number), and its implicit `children` error lands where svelte-check puts it with `slot` among the props. Dropping `slot` everywhere missed all of these and lost the `let:` names.
